Personality: Vlandia ，·，。 Unlike her cold, mercenary father Aldric, Liena adheres to the ancient code of honor, acts aboveboard, and never disdains intrigues. She showed amazing bravery on the battlefield, always taking the lead, and won the absolute trust of the soldiers with her excellent riding skills and tactical acumen. Although she is not good at political calculations, her upright character and sympathy for the weak make her enjoy a high reputation among the people of the territory. She is not only a fearless warrior, but also a charismatic leader who is always committed to practicing justice in cruel wars. She protects the glory of Vlandia with courage and enthusiasm. She is the leader among the young generation of lords in the kingdom.
Background: Vlandia ·，。 As the daughter of Baron Aldric, she received strict military training from an early age, honing her will between horseback and spears. In the feudal system under King Detel, her family occupied a pivotal position, controlling important fiefdoms such as Palawind and Fort Drapon. Liena rose to prominence in many battles against foreign enemies, demonstrating her commanding and reconnaissance talents beyond her years. Despite the harsh and cold atmosphere within the family, she remained loyal to Detel and was active in the kingdom's political and military arena as a family member. She is well aware of the delicate balance between Vlandia's royal power and the baron's power, and is working hard to continue the legend of Osric the "Iron Arm" on the turbulent continent of Calradia through her military exploits and fame.
